'''Gwira Bolani''' was a [[human]] who worked as a [[flatbread]] [[Chef|baker]] in the street markets of [[Olega City]], [[capital]] of the [[planet]] [[Olega]], during the [[High Republic Era]]. She made unleavened and conveniently portable specialties with exotic toppings and the scents from her oven attracted eager customers.<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> In [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> Bolani walked past the entryway to the [[Olega Jedi temple]] in the [[city]] while a group of [[Jedi]] were [[Skirmish on Olega|interrogating]] the street urchin<ref name="RevengeJustice">{{Acolyte|Revenge / Justice}}</ref> [[Guthan Archi]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

She was then looking at goods on a stall near the [[Olega Apothecary]] when the Jedi's ally [[Verosha Aniseya]] bought a [[Clothing|robe]] from<ref name="RevengeJustice" /> the [[merchant]] [[Luntobetha]]<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> nearby.<ref name="RevengeJustice" /> Gwira had light skin and long braids of [[hair]] with bands of blonde, ginger, and black coloring. She wore brown robes<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> with brown [[boot]]s<ref name="RevengeJustice" /> and a gray [[Hat|turban]] on top of which was strung a tray of goods with a strung together cover hanging down her back.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gwira Bolani appeared in "[[Revenge / Justice]],"<ref name="RevengeJustice" /> the second episode of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired on [[June 4]], [[2024]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> The character was not identified in the episode<ref name="RevengeJustice" /> but was named in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />
